incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate on infer-gateway-prod (window=3m) — service=infer-gateway, error_rate=6.9% (>3% threshold) — Pager: @oncall-elena
oncall-elena: I'm on it — joining runway. Matt, Priya, can you please ping if you see anything obvious? :rotating_light:
matt: looking now — pulling logs from model-runner pool for customer-facing cluster
priya: I see a recent spike in kernel OOMs on node gpu-13, plus multiple model-runner pods restarted with SIGSEGV in the same minute
matt: confirmed. snippet from model-runner log:
```
[2026-03-17T21:34:02Z] model-runner[pid=4123] ERROR: segfault at 0x7fffe3b0
Backtrace:
  0x00007f8c12ab3cde  (libquant.so+0x13cde)
  0x00007f8c12ab4b00  (libattn.so+0x24b00)
  kill: invoked oom_killer: process model-runner killed
```
matt: kernel dmesg on gpu-13 shows repeated "Out of memory: Killed process" entries — looks like memory spike during a long decode path
priya: i've started a live tail of ktrace and nvprof on the node to confirm memory growth pattern. attaching quick probe output: `nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,name,used_memory --format=csv` shows runner process at ~38GB used
oncall-elena: customer impact? Aaron, any CS signals?
aaron: Support: we've got ~4 inbound threads from two midmarket customers (fin-app, docs-ai) reporting timeouts/502s in last 12m. Attach IDs: FIN-2341, DOCS-778. Estimated affected requests ~4% of total.
dave: product — we're seeing elevated latency buckets too. Can we route traffic away from gpu-13 and fallback to lower-capacity but stable model? Need status page update if impact persists >15m
priya: immediate mitigations: 1) cordon+drain gpu-13, 2) scale up model-runner replicas in pool, 3) shift portion of traffic to fallback model (smaller quantized variant)
matt: doing cordon+drain now — `kubectl cordon gpu-13 && kubectl drain node/gpu-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force`
infra-bot: runbook step executed: drain-node gpu-13 by matt — timestamp 1799997921
priya: traffic reroute command (issued): `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/infer-router TRAFFIC_SPLIT='{"primary":0.6,"fallback":0.4}'` — starting gradual 40% to fallback model: redwood-llama-q4f-small-v1
matt: scaled runner pool +2 replicas: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-runner --replicas=12`
oncall-elena: monitoring errors/latency; set alert threshold to page if >3% persisting 10m
priya: quick healthcheck after reroute: error_rate dropped to ~2.1% in gateway metrics (30s average). Latency median +30ms, p95 stable
aaron: CS: drafting status page update and in-app banner. tagging customers who reported issues. will post when approved
dave: ok post to status page with short blurb: "Partial latency and errors for inference requests due to a runtime memory crash on a GPU node; traffic rerouted and node drained; mitigation in progress; updates every 15m"
matt: note — GPU driver on gpu-13 shows a odd nvml reset just before OOM. collecting nvml logs and full dmesg for postmortem
priya: we'll keep fallback in place until we confirm no more segfaults + node reprovisioned. scheduling a hotpatch for quant attention kernel tomorrow AM if we can repro locally
oncall-elena: handoff plan: i'm primary for next 15m, then handing off to matt for night watch. matt — you ok to take the oncall after 21:50 UTC?
matt: can take it. will run a deeper memcheck and coordinate with infra to repro on a repro rig. also will keep fallback traffic until kernel/driver patch or node reprovision
infra-bot: ticket created: INFRA-4573 GPU node gpu-13 flagged for reprovision + nvml logs attached
aaron: customer comms queued, posting when matt confirms stable metrics for 20m
priya: summary of actions taken: [cordon+drain node gpu-13], [scale model-runner +2], [reroute 40% -> fallback model], [collect logs/dmesg/nvml], [create infra ticket].
oncall-elena: closing incident channel for now — move to #incidents-postmortems once triage complete. if errors spike again, page immediately. :thumbsup:
matt: last check at 21:48 UTC: error_rate 1.6%, GPU node offline; leaving fallback until tomorrow. handing oncall to me at 21:50 UTC.
priya: adding follow-ups: reproduce with long decode prompts, run valgrind on quant kernels, test with smaller batch sizes, add guard rails to OOM kill detection to auto-reroute early
oncall-elena: thanks everyone. filing initial incident notes to wiki and tagging SRE, runtime, and support for postmortem.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Status=mitigated (reduced error rate), impact=partial (4% requests), actions=reroute/drain/scale, severity=sev2, incident_channel archived to incidents-postmortems
